original: Use storytelling and narratives
text: Use storytelling and narratives, e.g., podcasts with bite-sized chunks.

original: Provide AI-powered search functions to find tailored cases
text: Consider developing an AI-powered search tool for tailored case studies, e.g., using “COM-B, leadership, automotive industry” as search terms.

original: Position behavioural research earlier in decision-making
text: Include behavioural science at the start of policy development.

original: Invest in organisational-level capability, including formal facilitating roles
text: Invest in organisational capability, e.g., through a council research facilitator who builds links with local universities and supports research governance.
sources: Appendix B, Table B3, Public & Third 2

original: Include mentorship and implementation support
text: Provide mentorship and support alongside behavioural research training to help people apply their skills.

original: Create funder collectives for larger projects
text: Create a research funder collective that could provide larger budgets for large-scale projects.

original: Target local authority partnerships
text: Target research calls at local authorities or partnerships involving them to investigate health behaviours within their responsibilities.
sources: Appendix B, Table B6, Public & Third 2

original: Support cross-sector collaboration
text: Provide more funding for cross-sector collaboration, e.g., between academia and industry.

original: Define impact and success realistically when working with funders
text: Define impact realistically with funders, accounting for delayed behavioural outcomes in design and evaluation timelines.

original: Create formal supportive leadership positions within organisations
text: Create formal behavioural science leadership roles to clarify its place in the organisation and raise its status.

original: Identify and support organisational champions
text: Identify organisational champions and support them with training.

original: Train leaders on strategic planning and realistic expectations
text: Train leaders on realistic timelines and resource needs, and how to build behavioural research into organisational planning.

original: Co-design solutions with affected populations and advisory groups
text: Co-design solutions with affected populations and advisory groups, e.g., work with people in arrears on rates bills to identify barriers and practical solutions.

original: Educate clients and stakeholders about research processes
text: Educate clients and stakeholders about research processes while meaningfully including public involvement and lived experiences.

original: Ensure local and national government involvement in research for policy impact
text: Include local authorities and government as funding partners for national policy implementation, despite their budget constraints.

original: Bridge gaps between sectors and disciplines
text: Create transdisciplinary roles to bridge gaps between fields and educate sectors on collaboration processes.

original: Facilitate cross-sector learning and collaboration
text: Draw on successful case studies from other sectors, e.g., health, to support cross-sector learning.

original: Move beyond individual behaviour models
text: Move beyond individual-only models to frameworks that include group, organisational or structural influences.

original: Use systems mapping as a foundation
text: Use systems mapping before designing interventions.

original: Focus on long-term and sustainable change
text: Support research that examines long-term change across systems.

original: Clear definitions and terminology
text: Clarify behavioural research terminology to reduce confusion and misinformation.

original: Methodological standards
text: Establish trusted, sector-wide guidance on methodological standards, including ethical evaluation, research governance and data protection.

original: Sector-specific guidance
text: Develop sector-specific resources and case studies to make behavioural research more accessible and relevant.
